dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple circular and elliptical 'O' structures are visible along the dorsal ridge. These features possess high-contrast, jagged white perimeters that exhibit a sharp gradient transition from dark grey interiors to bright white exterior rings with irregular, non-geometric margins.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high-density region of irregular, amorphous white clusters is localized on the anterior-lateral flank. These clusters consist of solid high-intensity pixel groups lacking internal gradients, featuring dendritic or cloud-like edge structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle. Connecting these centroids to the centroid of the large anterior-lateral blob cluster defines a broad, irregular quadrilateral across the upper-mid section of the visible surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, large, elongated high-intensity white formation on the forward-left lateral side, which is significantly more complex and occupies a larger pixel area than the standard annular markings distributed across the rest of the body.
